decision_notes: The council website explicitly designates its YouTube service. Two distinct recorded sittings (313th fourth and fifth plenaries) were visually reviewed beyond opening slates in Chromium and WebKit, with advancing decoded video, a presiding chair or member speaking in the identified chamber and an inset sign-language interpreter. This confirms selected recorded proceedings; current live, every committee/room and all language tracks remain unverified. Open the council website and its designated video service.

Official council website link only. Its own site designates the video provider. The reviewed CCTV/privacy policy is not a licence for public session recordings; a current, separate audiovisual reuse permission was not established. Retain permission pending and do not embed, rehost or export provider streams.
